title: Solution ideation (non-monetary constraint)
purpose: Once you know the real mix, solutions map onto friction types. Illustrative directions only — not a build list without Phase 3 data. No coupons, cashback, or markdown.
north_star: Wishlist / consideration → purchase conversion on Myntra — only where conversion is the right metric (not moodboarders).
constraint: Non-monetary: reassurance, information, comparison, timing, list architecture. No ₹ off.
output: 2–4 non-monetary sketches per ranked friction, bound to the Phase 3 cell. Plus the inspiration vs ready-to-buy split.
status_note: These are directions that show what non-monetary solutioning looks like. Do not treat them as a roadmap until Phase 3 ranks the mix. Do not A/B a coupon.
biggest_lever_hypothesis: Separating inspiration board from ready-to-buy may be the single biggest lever: mixing bookmarking and genuine-intent cohorts dilutes the headline metric.

ideas: Fit-prediction from purchase and return history
Richer size-specific reviews (runs small) and body-type filters
AR / virtual try-on
Size-exchange guarantee messaging (reassurance, not a discount)
In-wishlist comparison view (side-by-side across saved similar items)
Most saved by people who also saved this
Editorial styling picks that collapse near-duplicates
Shareable wishlist for friend feedback
Review summarization focused on fit / quality (not just star ratings)
UGC / try-on video surfacing
Tag wishlist items with an event / date
Remind as the date approaches (timing-based, not price-based)
Smart resurfacing of high-intent items (revisit frequency), not every SKU equally
Wishlist decluttering nudges for aged, never-reopened items
Do not force conversion
Separate inspiration board from ready-to-buy list
Point the headline metric at genuine-intent users, not moodboarders
Constraint forbids markdown
Information / timing only (price since save, restock waitlist)
If the only lever is a coupon, leave it out of this backlog
Usually remove / declutter, not a conversion play
Do not win back items the user has decided against
